tweets.text:
In June 2024, Swanton Sector agents apprehended 3,310 individuals entering the U.S. illegally. One year later, in June 2025, that number dropped to 119 apprehensions from 24 different countries. Despite the significant decrease in cross border apprehensions this still represents a serious threat to national security.

Border security is national security, which directly correlates to public safety.

Please report suspicious border activity in Swanton Sector by calling 1-800-689-3362. Your call makes a difference!
